stageMeta.title: First Agent: the L0→L1 conceptual jump
headerComment: # Stage 01 — First Agent: the L0→L1 conceptual jump
# Same Q&A as Stage 00, but now through the full Agent spine:
#   session + system-prompt + tools (empty registry) + agent + agent-loop
# Same user task, same provider, same model as Stage 00.
# What changes is the MACHINERY around the LLM call:
#   a session log, turn/step boundaries, an agent identity.
# (dsh-system-prompt also injects a default Harness identity, so the
#  actual request is not byte-for-byte identical — but the user task is.)
# No tools are registered — dsh-tools is an empty registry.
# The model cannot call tools; it can only answer from knowledge.
# This is deliberate: the lesson is "LLM ≠ Agent", not "look, tools".
stageMeta.driverQuestion: 用一句话说明插件化架构的好处
